description: WHEN one ticker's off-exchange (dark pool) volume traded, by price, for a date (default latest): a 5-minute × price grid of shares, the point of control and value area, and the largest block prints at their report time (outside_nbbo flags prints reported beyond the quote, away_from_quote those priced away from it: >0.1% and 2 cents outside). cells_side gives each cell's [buy, sell, away] shares (buy = at the ask + 60% near it, sell = at the bid + 60% near it, away left out, rest neutral); totals add buy_volume, sell_volume, away_volume. Side is an NBBO-location proxy, not buy/sell; ~15 min delayed. Use for 'when did the dark pool trade NVDA around 180?'. Pro.
name: darkpool_time_profile
title: Dark pool time profile
